answer_1.quote: Effective automatic generation of functional code from visual designs has the potential to democratize the development of front-end web applications, allowing non-experts to build applications easily and quickly.
answer_1.outputs: HTML and CSS code implementation from website design images

answer_2.quote: We propose to automatically evaluate generated webpages by calculating the similarity between the screenshots of reference webpages I_R and the rendered screenshots of generated webpages I_G.

answer_4.quote: By recruiting human annotators (paid at the rate of $16/hour) from Prolific, we conducted a series of human evaluations to compare across models and methods, as well as to assess the quality of AI-generated webpages directly.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to check in order of priority: (1) Content (text and image content), (2) Layout (element arrangement), (3) Style (font, color, size). They judge which candidate is more similar to the reference or if they are a tie.
